body.x: SONY participated in ‘CES 2018(Consumer Technology Show)’, the world’s largest IT consumer electronics show held in Las Vegas, the U.S.A. from Tues. 9th to Fri. 12th in Jan. and introduced various audio equipment, earphones and speakers.

Sony has introduced LF 550G, srx sb31, srx sb41, wf sp700f, wf sp700n, wf1000x, wi 1000x, wi sp600n and among them, LF550G is a voice-enabled speaker in a new style The speaker is a Bluetooth speaker and it can be used by connecting audio device directly if desired. It can operate functions such as boosting volume, skipping to the next track, via voice helper. The wf1000x is a Bluetooth earphone that can automatically switch to sound mode depending on the user’s activity. It also boasts vivid and clear sound. Besides various sound equipment was developed and opened to many people.

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
